name: Mana Shield
description: When active, create a mana shield around you that reduces physical damage taken and absorbs a portion of damage taken as mana.

zh.name: 法力护盾
zh.description: 激活时，在你周围生成一面法力护盾，降低所受物理伤害，并将一部分所受伤害以法力吸收。

zh.name: 魔性之息
zh.description: 提高你的奥术技能伤害。

name: Mana Devour
description: Instantly restores a portion of your mana.

zh.name: 吞噬法力
zh.description: 立即恢复你的一部分法力。

name: Blood Surge
description: Channel a massive surge of blood towards target direction dealing arcane damage to enemies in its path.

zh.name: 鲜血奔涌
zh.description: 朝目标方向引导一股巨大的鲜血洪流，对路径上的敌人造成奥术伤害。

subskills.name: Blood Surge
subskills.description: Core of the Blood Surge subtree.

zh.name: 鲜血奔涌
zh.description: 鲜血奔涌 子树核心。

subskills.name: Corrosive Blood
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by blood surge.

zh.name: 腐蚀鲜血
zh.description: 提高造成的伤害鲜血奔涌。

subskills.name: Wide Veins
subskills.description: Increases the area of effect radius of blood surge.

zh.name: Wide 血脉
zh.description: 提高 effect radius of 鲜血奔涌 的范围。

subskills.name: White Blood Cells
subskills.description: Increases the duration of blood surge.

zh.name: White 鲜血 Cells
zh.description: 提高 鲜血奔涌 的持续时间。

subskills.name: Increased Plasma
subskills.description: Decreases the mana cost of blood surge.

zh.name: 提高 Plasma
zh.description: 降低法力消耗之鲜血奔涌。

subskills.name: Blood Fervor
subskills.description: Chance to inflict burning on hit.

zh.name: 鲜血 Fervor
zh.description: 命中时有概率施加燃烧。

subskills.name: Immune Deficiency
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt to burning targets.

zh.name: 免疫 Deficiency
zh.description: 提高对 燃烧目标 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Asphyxiating Vessels
subskills.description: Chance to inflict arcane break on hit.

zh.name: 窒息 Vessels
zh.description: 命中时有概率施加奥术击破。

subskills.name: Demon Wings
subskills.description: Decreases movement diminish when using blood surge.

zh.name: 恶魔 Wings
zh.description: 使用鲜血奔涌时降低移动衰减。

subskills.name: Vein Pressure
subskills.description: Chance to unleash a critical strike with increased critical strike damage.

zh.name: Vein 压迫
zh.description: 概率释放暴击 strike 使用提高暴击伤害。

subskills.name: Rays of Blood
subskills.description: Chance on hit to unleash additional surges of blood to directions around the target on hit.

zh.name: 射线之鲜血
zh.description: 命中时有概率释放额外涌动之鲜血至方向周围目标命中时。

subskills.name: Hematopoiesis
subskills.description: Increases the tick frequency of blood surge.

zh.name: Hematopoiesis
zh.description: 提高 鲜血奔涌 的每跳 frequency。

subskills.name: Channeling Surge
subskills.description: Blood surge deals increased damage and no longer expires until you run out of mana or cast blood surge again.

zh.name: Channeling 涌动
zh.description: 鲜血奔涌造成提高伤害与更久到期 until 你 run out 之法力施法鲜血奔涌 again。

subskills.name: Blood Line
subskills.description: Unleash two surges of blood curving to your sides before expiring.

zh.name: 鲜血 Line
zh.description: 释放双涌动之鲜血 curving 至你的 sides before 到期。

subskills.name: Unlimited Power
subskills.description: Conjure an orb of blood unleashing surges of blood towards targets on hit. Blood surge now has a cooldown.

zh.name: Unlimited 力量
zh.description: 召唤宝珠之鲜血释放涌动之鲜血朝向目标命中时。鲜血奔涌有 cooldown。

name: Blood Demons
description: Chance on spellcast to summon a blood demon towards the closest monster dealing arcane damage.

zh.name: 血魔
zh.description: 施法时有概率朝最近的怪物召唤一只血魔，造成奥术伤害。

name: Blood Tendrils
description: Blood surge now causes its target to release blood tendrils for a portion of its damage.

zh.name: 鲜血触须
zh.description: 鲜血奔涌现在会使目标释放鲜血触须，造成其一部分伤害。
